I will keep this nuts plot low-cash, the way I have been doing unless I see a clear reason to spend more. On this side in Mtwara, many of us do not put chemical fertilizer on such a small plot, but I do use some manure around the trees when I have it because this is my own land and it is worth maintaining. I will stay with local planting material, spray when pests become a problem, and depend on the rains because I do not have irrigation on this plot. Most of the work I will do with family, then I will bring a few laborers when work comes together.
